notes.title: B1.0.0.7-DEMO Minor Update
notes.content:
Another small update to make some changes based on player feedback and to fix some bugs.


Gameplay:
Increased player base movement speed.

Updated enemy AI to respond quicker when spawning.

Updated flying enemies to move more after shooting.


Bug Fixes:
Fixed melee enemy pausing before attacking when close.

Removed secondary bind for dash that was causing errors when rebinding the F key. 

Updated boss attacks that were failing to knock the player back resulting in excessive damage.

notes.title: B1.0.0.6-DEMO Minor Update
notes.content:
Update to add a new weapon and fix some errors.



The poison Pump weapon barrel shoots a ball of poison slime that damages enemies it hits as well as leaving behind a puddle of poison that will damage and poison enemies that move through it.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048037/fb433a40f3c6dde3bb2bd213c5bcb36ad03b76ee.png"]
Gameplay:
Added updates to tutorial to make movement mechanics clearer. 

Added new poison weapon barrel.


Bug Fixes:
Changed hit audio cue to not play when damage over time affects trigger.

Stopped enemies from spawning on top of each other and getting stuck.

Fixed enemies waiting too long before attacking.

notes.title: B1.0.0.5-DEMO Minor Update
notes.content:
Another small update to address some concerns and fix some errors.

Gameplay:

 Updated weapon hotbar graphic to show a crosshair on the selected weapon.
 Melee monsters learned how to strafe to make easy levels a little more challenging.
 Hit particles now scale based on amount of damage.
 Reload animation is no longer canceled when dashing.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed errors when closing menus with esc or pause keys.
 Fixed problem with crystal spike extra's target from sometimes being left behind.

notes.title: B1.0.0.4-DEMO Minor Update
notes.content:
Gameplay: 

 Moved some portals away from chest spawns to prevent accidently not getting to open chests
 Add descriptive text to weapon upgrade machine 
 Improved controller bindings


Bug Fixes: 

 Fixed directional dashes and slide speed on controller
